name: Ambarish
reason: Realistic name (Ambarish/Ambrish is given today) but the meaning only names the king; the etymology of ambarīṣa is not certain (popular 'lord of the sky' is a folk reading).

fix.name: Ambarish
fix.meaning_en: Etymology uncertain; the devoted king of the Bhagavata Purana, a great Vishnu devotee.

name: Dasharath
reason: Correct meaning and script; Dasharath/Dashrath is still given, esp. in North India.

name: Gudakesh
reason: Attested Gita epithet of Arjuna (guḍākā + īśa, also read 'thick-haired'); rare but used as a given name.

name: Harishchandra
reason: Correct sandhi (hari + candra → hariścandra); hari = golden; well-established given name.

name: Janak
reason: Common given name; meaning and script correct.

name: Kaunteya
reason: Metronymic of Arjuna, used as a modern given name; meaning correct.

name: Kiriti
reason: Kiriti/Kireeti is a common given name (esp. Bengal, Andhra); 'crowned one' is correct.

name: Kush
reason: Common name; meaning and script correct.

name: Luv
reason: Common name, but the meaning only names the figure; lava means 'a moment, a small part'.

fix.name: Luv
fix.meaning_en: A moment, a small part; one of Rama's twin sons.

name: Markandeya
reason: Given name (Markandey/Markandeya), but meaning should state the patronymic sense of the name.

fix.name: Markandeya
fix.meaning_en: Son of the sage Mrikandu; the long-lived sage saved from death by Shiva.

name: Nal
reason: Acceptable rare name, but meaning gives only figures; nala means 'reed'.

fix.name: Nal
fix.meaning_en: Reed; the righteous king of the Nala-Damayanti story, also the vanara who built Rama's bridge.

name: Pavak
reason: Used given name; 'fire, the purifier' is correct.

name: Raghu
reason: Common name; 'swift' and dynasty founder correct.

name: Rantidev
reason: Rare but auspicious and attested name; meaning should give the parts, with honest uncertainty.

fix.name: Rantidev
fix.meaning_en: Etymology uncertain, roughly 'delight of the gods' (ranti 'delight' + deva 'god'); the generous king who gave away his last food.

name: Satyaki
reason: Used as a given name; patronymic meaning correct.

name: Savyasachi
reason: Attested Arjuna epithet used as a given name; meaning correct.

name: Shatrughna
reason: Common name; meaning and script correct.

name: Shibi
reason: Given name (esp. South India), but meaning only names the king; etymology of śibi is uncertain.

fix.name: Shibi
fix.meaning_en: Etymology uncertain; the king who offered his own flesh to save a dove.

name: Sugreev
reason: Su + grīvā gives sugrīva; meaning correct; given occasionally.

name: Sushen
reason: Correct (su + senā → suṣeṇa); Sushen is a used given name.

name: Vibhishan
reason: negative_meaning: literally 'terrifying', and 'Vibhishan' is a common Hindi byword for a traitor ('ghar ka bhedi'); essentially never given to boys.

name: Yogeshwar
reason: Common name; 'lord of yoga', Krishna; correct sandhi.
